summary: An attack aimed at you: At {the event}, or through the mail, someone attacks you or your people, and {the place} watches what you do next.
realLife: One life: In 2011 she was shot in the head at a meeting with constituents outside a Tucson grocery store; six people died. She returned to vote that August, and a wounded staffer, Ron Barber, later won her seat. Another: In July 2024 he was shot in the ear at an outdoor rally and raised his fist. The head of the Secret Service resigned after hearings. Another: In October 2001 an aide in his Senate office opened a letter containing anthrax. Another: In 2011 a caller threatened his wife and daughter. The caller pleaded guilty and went to prison.
gates: You hold an office or are a candidate.
An attack or threat against you, your staff or your office is on record.
weights: How badly you or your staff were hurt.
How heated the race had been.
